question: What is the air quality in Central Singapore right now?
name: ChatGPT
answer:
Central Singapore’s latest NEA reading is **PSI 226 — Very Unhealthy**, recorded at **8:00 a.m. Singapore time on October 16**. PSI is a 24-hour measure, so it reflects conditions over the preceding day rather than the air at this exact moment. ([api-open.data.gov.sg](https://api-open.data.gov.sg/v2/real-time/api/psi))

NEA advises avoiding prolonged or strenuous outdoor activity when PSI is Very Unhealthy. Check NEA’s latest **1-hour PM2.5** reading for immediate conditions. ([nea.gov.sg](https://www.nea.gov.sg/media/news/advisories/index/haze-situation-update-15-october-2026))
